AtruhaTeX Pi 3.1 — internal build 4.

Writing tools: chapter organization within a file, supervisor review with project chat and document comments, Zotero reading notes and annotations, collaboration invitations and activity, manuscript notation, scientific clipboard conversion, and chapter editing permissions. Shared collaboration features require the updated account server.

Editor fixes: preserve mixed Arabic/English source layout and syntax highlighting while typing; place the first click at the chosen line without revealing the previous caret.

Built and packaged without running automated tests, launching the application, or testing installation. Manual Windows acceptance is pending. Save your documents before installing. After updating, check mixed-direction typing, highlighting, and clicking a visible line after scrolling away from the old caret.

The visible version remains Pi 3.1 / 1.0.1. This package is internal build 4; the About label stays unchanged.
